name: js-truncate
instruction: Implement truncate.js (CommonJS): module.exports = truncate. truncate(str, maxLen, ellipsis='…') returns str unchanged when its length is <= maxLen. Otherwise it cuts at the last WORD boundary that keeps the TOTAL length (text + ellipsis) <= maxLen, and appends the ellipsis. If no word boundary fits, hard-cut mid-word instead. Trailing whitespace before the ellipsis must be trimmed. Throw a RangeError when maxLen is shorter than the ellipsis itself.
verifyCmd: node -e "const t=require('./truncate.js');if(t('hello world',5)!=='hell…'&&t('hello world',5)!=='hello'.slice(0,4)+'…'){console.error('hard cut',JSON.stringify(t('hello world',5)));process.exit(1)}const r=t('the quick brown fox',10);if(r.length>10){console.error('too long',JSON.stringify(r));process.exit(1)}if(!r.endsWith('…')){console.error('no ellipsis');process.exit(1)}if(/\\s…$/.test(r)){console.error('untrimmed space before ellipsis',JSON.stringify(r));process.exit(1)}if(t('abc',3)!=='abc'){console.error('exact fit unchanged');process.exit(1)}try{t('abcdef',0);console.error('no throw');process.exit(1)}catch(e){if(!(e instanceof RangeError))process.exit(1)}console.log('ok')"
